children.name: Evidence
children.value: Vorbis comment ENCODER field at 0x43 names "Lavf60.16.100"

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The block size is 4,608 samples in every frame but the last; levels 3 to 12 use it.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The highest linear predictor order is 12; 24 of 24 subframes are linear predictors.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Every linear predictor has a coefficient precision of 15 bits, the one FFmpeg's encoder writes.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Levels 8, 9 or 10 set a highest linear predictor order of 12, a highest partition order of 8 and a block size of 4,608 samples.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The highest linear predictor order of the frames equals what the named levels set; their highest partition order, or the one below it, is used by at least a fifth of the subframes.
